name: Misfit Agent Control Plane
purpose: Public-safe recovery and discovery manifest for the Misfit machine/agent stack. Private GHOSBC runtime internals are intentionally excluded.
continuity: Canonical runtime state lives in Misfit Cloud/Supabase; source and recovery metadata live in GitHub; misfitmediahouse.com publishes the public control surface. Chat sessions are operators, not databases.

stack.name: Agent Revenue Factory
stack.summary: Autonomous machine-revenue operator for health, discovery, conversion and safe zero-cost deployment.

stack.name: GHOSBC OS – Agent Brain Hub
stack.summary: Private upstream cognitive and governance kernel used by Misfit-controlled systems. It is not a public product or external runtime surface.

stack.name: Misfit Shield – GHOSBC Sentinel
stack.summary: Private defensive sentinel interface for outbound-context protection, tripwires, security policy and threat visualization.

stack.name: Misfit Machine Agent
stack.summary: Public A2A agent for public metadata audits and bounded advisory governance checks. Private GHOSBC implementation details remain behind the Misfit-controlled boundary and are not advertised as a separate product.

stack.name: Misfit Business Scrub
stack.summary: Free public-signal business website diagnostic with prioritized revenue leaks, offer routing and a human-approved lead handoff. Never logs in, submits target forms, mutates a site, purchases or moves money.

stack.name: Misfit A2A Agent Trust Audit
stack.summary: Free public-metadata-only A2A Agent Card/binding/skill/security/registry trust audit with a rerunnable share URL and embeddable badge. Never sends a task or executes a target-agent skill.

stack.name: Misfit Agent Evaluation Lab
stack.comparison: Authorized Raw Agent vs governed-agent runs across the same objective and scenario.
stack.claims_boundary: Comparative evidence and integration findings only. Not certification, regulatory attestation, machine-consciousness evidence, or proof of universal safety.
stack.privacy_boundary: Protected kernel source, private prompts, hidden policy internals, credentials, protected packets and reconstruction material are excluded.
stack.summary: Measurable Raw Agent versus governed-agent evaluation package with bounded public-safe reporting and machine-native contract, API, MCP and A2A discovery.

stack.name: ChangePacket
stack.summary: Low-token change memory for public webpages and MCP tool surfaces.

stack.name: Misfit Shopify Agentic Audit
stack.summary: Free public-metadata-only Shopify UCP, agents.md and MCP readiness/tool-surface audit with a shareable live badge. Never executes cart, checkout, order, payment, credential or mutation actions.

stack.name: Misfit Machine Store
stack.summary: UCP-compatible machine catalog and MCP storefront for current public Misfit products.

stack.name: ContextForge
stack.summary: Metadata-aware code generation and change governance grounded in DataHub context.

security.public_boundary: sanitized metadata, decisions, audit receipts/digests and documented tool contracts only
security.consequential_actions: require explicit bounded authorization or review
security.private_core: GHOSBC/Castle Gate internals, private prompts, cipher/mapping material, credentials and reconstruction material are never published

recovery.rule: Never publish GHOSBC private runtime material, cipher/mapping internals, founder-private prompts, credentials, secrets or reconstruction material.
